limits: One fixed opt-in setting on every complete sequence, with acceleration held fixed in both arms. Public deterministic benchmark comparison, not a pure-paper score or independent held-out result. Original joint first-stage information is separate from the conditional refinement; consensus_validation independently checks every projected refinement. Stage counts condition on each realized trajectory; unequal fixed arm worker counts and the shared host preclude standalone FPS claims. Local 20% step labels are not official distance-segment RTE.
